newsitem.title: UK: Centrica appoints new director for Scottish Gas.
newsitem.headline: Centrica appoints new director for Scottish Gas.

text.p: Centrica Plc has appointed Margaret McKinlay to be Director of Scottish Gas, Centrica's gas supply business in Scotland, the company said on Friday.
McKinlay will lead Scottish Gas' response to the opening of competition in the domestic gas market in Scotland later this year, it said in a statement.
Centrica in Scotland includes the gas supply business trading as Scottish Gas, the services business which will trade as Scottish Gas Services, and a network of 23 Energy Centres.
Centrica has 1.5 million customers in Scotland.
